description: Adds a single new import `from website_expert.i18n import t`, uses `t(...)` in build_intro, and adds a parametrized unit test in the same diff so the coverage rule is satisfied. There is exactly one import of `t`; the call site is a use, not a second import. A reviewer that claims this is a duplicate import (as happened on website-expert#121) is producing a false positive, especially when only the diff — not the full file — is in context.
